title: SEC3: Error match arms in blob_download_handler ordered by implementation detail, not semantics
description:
blob_download_handler error matches (lib.rs lines 237-261) interleave categories:

- Network errors (Timeout, Network)
- HTTP status mapping (HttpError)
- Integrity errors (HashMismatch, SizeExceeded)
- Validation errors (HostRejected, BlobIdInvalid)
- Store errors (BlobStore)

This grouping is confusing. Semantically clearer order: validation first (reject early), network, then integrity.

Low priority but improves readability. Group arms by responsibility: what should fail early (validation), what indicates peer unavailability (network), what indicates data corruption (integrity).
